corrections.mechanism: Published inspection now requires a hash-bound publication receipt. It checks the remote annotated tag commit, completed successful push run for deploy.yml at the same source and attempt, both selected run artifact IDs and downloaded digest filenames, the selected child, both index children and the actual image OS/architecture. The existing deployment workflow exports those digest filenames; no workflow change is part of this review.
corrections.falsifying_observation: Substituting a different source image while retaining the expected receipt now fails selected-child equality, actual workflow digest-export equality, or exact index-child equality. Merely matching the local tag no longer satisfies published provenance.
corrections.limit: No GitHub API, artifact download, registry pull or published gate was executed. Actual publication receipt, immutable release identity and architecture acceptance remain pending; missing/expired exports deny acceptance.
